Pursuant to the Governor's Executive Order N-29-20, Planning Commission Members will be participating via
teleconference.

- Commission meeting videos are live-streamed on the City’s website at www.rhe.city/agendas and available for
viewing thereafter. Commission meetings are recorded for minutes preparation purposes.

- Members of the public may listen to the meeting live by calling: (1-669-900-6833) from any phone, Meeting ID:
880 8804 2333 Passcode: 698775. (Please note you will not have the ability to speak using the call-in option from
a phone line.)

-  Public  correspondence  may  be  emailed  to  Carol Corea, Administrative  Assistant  at
carolc@rollinghillsestatesca.gov. Emails received before 5:00 p.m. the night of the meeting will be forwarded to
the Commission for their consideration and included as part of the record.

- Members of the public may comment online using eComment on the “Meeting Agendas, Minutes & Videos”
page of the City’s website (www.rhe.city/agendas). Once the agenda is published, there will be an “eComment”
button next to the linked agenda under "Upcoming Events". Follow this link to the City’s SpeakUp page. After
you register, you may comment on any item on that particular agenda. These comments can be seen by the
public, will be considered by the Commission and become part of the record.

- Members of the public who wish to speak during this meeting, may join by visiting http://www.zoom.com/join
and enter the following credentials: Meeting ID: 880 8804 2333 Passcode: 698775.

- If using a tablet or phone, download the Zoom app and enter the following credentials: Meeting ID: 880 8804
2333 Passcode: 698775.

Members of the public who join the Zoom meeting will not have video, and may request to speak using the
following process: After joining the Zoom meeting, if you wish to speak, please select the "raise hand" option at
the lower portion of your screen. The host will send you a chat message to identify which item on the agenda you
would like to speak on and will unmute your mic at the appropriate time.

Agenda reports and other disclosable public records relating to each agenda item are available on the City's
website under Meeting Agendas, Minutes & Videos at www.rhe.city/agendas.

MINUTES
  PLANNING COMMISSION MEETING
  MONDAY, OCTOBER 4, 2021

  A regular meeting of the Planning Commission of the City of Rolling Hills Estates was called to
  order by CHAIR EDLER at 7:02 p.m. Pursuant to the Governor’s Executive Order N-29-20, this
  meeting was held via teleconference.

  2.  SALUTE TO THE FLAG

  CHAIR EDLER led those assembled in the Pledge of Allegiance.

  3.  ROLL CALL

  Commissioners Present:  Edler, Carman, Schachter, Scott*, Yoo, Zigrang

  Commissioners Absent:  Medawar

  City Staff Present:  David Wahba, Director of Community Development and Public Works
  Jeannie Naughton, Planning Manager
  Carol Corea, Administrative Assistant

  * Arrived after approval of the minutes

  4.  APPROVAL OF MINUTES

  A.  APPROVAL OF PLANNING COMMISSION MEETING MINUTES, AUGUST 2, 2021

  COMMISSIONER ZIGRANG made a motion, seconded by COMMISSIONER CARMAN to,

  APPROVE THE PLANNING COMMISSION MEETING MINUTES OF AUGUST 2,
  2021.

  There being no objection, CHAIR EDLER so ordered

  5.  AUDIENCE ITEMS

  NONE

  6.  CONSENT CALENDAR

  A.  APPROVE READING IN FULL OF ALL ORDINANCES AND RESOLUTIONS PRESENTED
  FOR CONSIDERATION TO THE PLANNING COMMISSION WILL BE WAIVED AND ALL
  SUCH ORDINANCES AND RESOLUTIONS WILL BE READY BY TITLE ONLY.

  COMMISSIONER ZIGRANG made a motion, seconded by COMMISSIONER YOO to,

  APPROVE ITEM NO. 6A

  There being no objection, CHAIR EDLER so ordered.

  7.  BUSINESS ITEMS

  A.  PLANNING APPLICATION NO. PA-210295; ADDRESS: 4 RUSTLER LANE, ROLLING
  HILLS ESTATES; APPLICANT: MS. ROSE PATINO; A request for approval of a
  Neighborhood Compatibility Determination (NC-210296) for one-story additions to be
  constructed along the front, side and rear yards to the existing single-story home and
  attached garage, and increasing the ridge height by 5.5 ft. above the existing residence.
  The proposed site improvements in the rear yard include construction of a pool house,
  pool/spa/equipment, covered patios and retaining walls. A Minor Deviation (MD-210297) is
  required to decrease the rear yard area by less than 10%. A Grading Permit (GR-210298)
  is required for grading in the rear yard.

  COMMISSIONER SCHACTHER notified Administrative Assistant Corea prior to the meeting that
  he would recuse himself from this item since his firm represents some of the people involved.

PLANNING COMMISSION MEETING
MINUTES, OCTOBER 4, 2021
  1
   Director Wahba presented Planning Application No. PA-210295 summarizing the staff report. This
  is a request for a Neighborhood Compatibility Determination for 95% demolition of the existing
  single-story home and construction of a slightly larger home with the roof increasing by 5.5 ft. above
  the existing residence. There will be grading in the rear yard to accommodate a pool and pool
  house. A Minor Deviation is requested for the reduction of the required rear yard by 10% from 35
  ft. to 31.5 ft. The house will be approximately 2800 sq. ft. and the garage will be approximately 467
  sq. ft.

  Director Wahba stated that staff recommends that the Planning Commission approve Planning
  Application No. PA-210295 with the conditions outlined in the staff report.

  Director Wahba asked if Ms. Rose Patino, Applicant, if she had an opportunity to speak with the
  property owner and neighbor regarding trees that may need to be removed at the rear of the
  property and the privacy concern having to do with the angle of the pool house.

  Ms. Patino stated that both property owners did come to agreement on a future landscape plan
  and the property owner for the proposed project agreed to tilt the pool house in order to address
  privacy concerns.

  Director Wahba recommended to the Planning Commission that a condition be added that staff will
  work with the property owner and the adjacent neighbor with respect to the pool house to make
  sure that it is positioned in a way to respect privacy.

  COMMISSIONER YOO asked if the neighbors objected to the proposed project. Director Wahba
  stated that it was a concern of the neighbor with not knowing how the pool house would be angled.

  Richard Herrera, Property Owner, stated that he did email the neighbor regarding the privacy issue
  and has not heard back from him but does not believe that privacy will be an issue due to the
  difference in elevation of 8–10 ft. between their yards. Mr. Herrera stated that the pool house could
  be tilted or eliminate the window facing the neighbor’s rear yard.

  COMMISSIONER ZIGRANG made a motion, seconded by COMMISSIONER YOO to,

  APPROVE PLANNING APPLICATION NO. PA-210295 SUBJECT TO THE CONDITIONS
  OUTLINED IN THE STAFF REPORT AND THE ADDITIONAL CONDITION THAT STAFF
  WILL WORK WITH THE PROPERTY OWNER AND ADJACENT NEIGHBOR ON THE
  LANDSCAPE PLAN AND THE LOCATION OF THE POOL HOUSE IN ORDER TO
  ADDRESS PRIVACY CONCERNS.

  AYES: EDLER, SCOTT, CARMAN, YOO, ZIGRANG
  NOES:
  ABSENT: MEDAWAR
  ABSTAIN: SCHACTHER

  Director Wahba stated that the Planning Commission has approved Planning Application No. PA-
  210295. An appeal of the Planning Commission decision may be made by any aggrieved party or
  the City Council in its own motion within 20 days after the Planning Commission renders its
  decision.

  8.  PUBLIC HEARINGS

  A.  PLANNING APPLICATION NO. PA-210231; ADDRESS 11 MONTECILLO DRIVE,
  ROLLING HILLS ESTATES, CA 90274; APPLICANT: PETER SMITH, ON BEHALF OF THE
  JACK KRAMER CLUB; A request to approve a Conditional Use Permit (CUP-210232) to
  amend CUP-102-87, revising the parking requirement methodology to be consistent with
  current standards. There are no proposed expansions to existing facilities or programming
  schedules.

  CHAIR EDLER recused himself from this item due to residing within 500’ of the subject property. He
  appointed Commissioner Schachter to serve as Chair for this item.

  Planning Manager Naughton stated that this item is to amend a Conditional Use Permit. Staff
  received an email from the applicant this afternoon at approximately 5:00 p.m., which was distributed
  to the Planning Commission as Supplemental No. 9. The email was a request to continue this item
  to the November 1st Planning Commission meeting to allow sufficient time for the applicant to have
  additional discussions with the residents of the Montecillo and Casaba neighborhoods.

  Planning Manager Naughton stated that staff recommends that the Planning Commission, open the
  public hearing, take no public testimony and continue this item to the November 1, 2021 Planning
PLANNING COMMISSION MEETING
MINUTES, OCTOBER 4, 2021
  2
   Commission meeting. Since this item will be continued to a date certain, there will be no noticing of
  this item.

  VICE CHAIR SCOTT asked that Dave Brunnenmeyer and Ed Mohr of the Montecillo Homeowners
  Association be notified that the meeting will be continued to the November 1st meeting. Planning
  Manager Naughton responded that she will and added that anyone who has provided comments for
  this item will be notified as well.

  COMMITTEE MEMBER ZIGRANG made a motion, seconded by COMMISSIONER YOO to,

  CONTINUE THIS ITEM TO THE NOVEMBER 1, 2021 PLANNING COMMISSION
  MEETING.

  There being no objection, CHAIR SCHACHTER so ordered.

  CHAIR EDLER rejoined the meeting at 8:24 p.m.

  9.  COMMISSIONER ITEMS

  COMMISSIONER SCHACHTER asked about progress on 42 Ranchview. Director Wahba stated
  that the property owners are out of town and will try to meet with them in the coming week.
  COMMISSIONER SCHACHTER asked about any complaints received for a home in the cul-de-sac
  at Palos Verdes Lane near Hawthorne Blvd. Director Wahba stated that he has received complaints
  and staff is working on it.

  COMMISSIONER SCOTT asked about 9 Lantana. Director Wahba stated that they have all of their
  approvals and are ready for permits to be issued.

  10.  MANAGER ITEMS

  NONE

  11.  MATTERS OF INFORMATION

  A.  CITY COUNCIL ACTIONS – AUGUST 10, 2021

  B.  CITY COUNCIL ACTIONS – AUGUST 24, 2021

  C.  CITY COUNCIL ACTIONS – SEPTEMBER 14, 2021

  COMMISSIONER YOO made a motion to receive and file Items 11A – 11C

  12.  ADJOURNMENT

  CHAIR EDLER adjourned the Planning Commission meeting at 8:27 p.m.

  Respectfully submitted by,  Approved,

  Carol Corea, Administrative Assistant  Rick Edler, Chair
